info.title: MifosSave API
info.description:
MifosSave API — layered over **Fineract 1.8.x** (Mifos X) and orchestrated by the MifosSave companion BFF.

**Group-centric model**: the savings group IS a Fineract Group (`m_group`, keyed by `groupId`) — the sole organizing unit, with no higher grouping tier.

**🔑 Two auth tiers — Authorize BOTH before you Execute:**
1. **Companion BFF paths** (`POST /auth/login`, `/groups/{id}/savings*`, `/groups/{id}/shareout/*`, `/groups/{id}/rotation/*`) — run the demo persona login, copy the returned `sessionToken`, Authorize → `sessionToken` tab.
2. **Direct-Fineract paths** (everything else — `/groups`, `/clients`, `/loans`, `/savingsaccounts`, `/datatables/*`, `/batches`, `/self/*`, `/runreports/*`) — these call Fineract 1.8.x directly and need Fineract's **own** HTTP Basic Auth, not the companion token. Authorize → `fineractBasicAuth` tab → username `mifos`, password `password` (dev creds for `mifos-bank-2`, per `idea-layer/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3). Once both are authorized, every endpoint on this page is live and demo-executable — the companion's group/client/loan/datatable orchestration tools (`server-layer/COMPANION_API_BUILD_DEPLOY.md`) will eventually front these with the companion token too, but until deployed, Basic Auth is the real path.

**Datatables**: 21 Mifos X datatables (15 domain + 6 companion) extend the core schema with VSLA/ROSCA/meeting/corpus state, reached via `/datatables/{table}/{apptableId}`.

tags.name: authentication
tags.description: POST /auth/login is companion BFF (Authorize → sessionToken). The dt_member_role endpoints are direct-Fineract (Authorize → fineractBasicAuth, mifos/password — see info description). Unified self-signup — single login screen, per-group role resolved post-auth via dt_member_role datatable.

tags.name: groups
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run these live. Savings group CRUD, group config (dt_group_config) and corpus (dt_group_corpus) datatables. Reads go through companion BFF; /groups/* is the Fineract write path.

tags.name: meetings
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run these live. Meeting schedule (dt_meeting_schedule), per-member attendance (dt_meeting_attendance), meeting summary records (dt_meeting_record), and end-of-cycle advance

tags.name: loans
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run these live. Loan application, group vote (dt_loan_vote), approve/disburse/reject state commands, list, and repayment collection during meeting

tags.name: offline-sync
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run this live. Fineract Batch API — one POST /batches replays the entire durable offline sync queue in order

tags.name: end-user-self-service
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run these live. Member-scoped reads over their own client profile, savings, and loans (Fineract /self/* tier) plus loan request submission to dt_loan_request

tags.name: clients-members
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run these live. Create Fineract clients (group members), associate to group, assign/update role (dt_member_role), upload photo, read profile and accounts

tags.name: savings
tags.description: Mixed tier: group/individual/member savings SUMMARIES are companion BFF (Authorize → sessionToken); raw /savingsaccounts/* (create/deposit/approve/transactions) is direct-Fineract (Authorize → fineractBasicAuth, mifos/password).

tags.name: share-out
tags.description: End-of-cycle distribution — strategy-aware preview then execute. ACCUMULATING (VSLA/ASCA/SHG/SILC): pro-rata. ROTATING_PAYOUT (ROSCA/chit): rotation/lottery/auction. Companion BFF only — Authorize → sessionToken.

tags.name: field-officer
tags.description: Direct-Fineract — Authorize → fineractBasicAuth (mifos/password) to run this live. v1.1 — Read-only cross-group MFI/NGO supervisory view: all assigned groups and the FieldOfficerGroupReport KPI rollup (read-only)

post.summary: Loan state command: approve / disburse / reject
post.description:
Execute a state transition on a loan via the `command` query parameter. These are Fineract state commands (NOT /transactions — that returns 404 for these). FIX S11: approve/disburse/reject are loan state commands on `/loans/{loanId}?command=...`, not on the transactions path.

- `command=approve`: approves a submitted loan. Body: `{approvedOnDate, locale, dateFormat}`
- `command=disburse`: disburses an approved loan (money out). Body: `{actualDisbursementDate, note, locale, dateFormat}`
- `command=reject`: rejects a submitted loan. Body: `{rejectedOnDate, locale, dateFormat}`

sessionToken.description: Companion BFF auth — paste the `sessionToken` returned by POST /auth/login. Authorizes ONLY the 6 companion-BFF endpoints (/groups/{id}/savings*, /shareout/*, /rotation/*). In the API Explorer: run POST /auth/login (pick a demo persona), copy the `sessionToken`, then click Authorize (top-right) → sessionToken tab, paste it.

fineractBasicAuth.description: Direct-Fineract auth for every other endpoint — Fineract's own HTTP Basic Auth (NOT the companion sessionToken). Dev credentials for the mifos-bank-2 instance (SoT: idea-layer/ARCHITECTURE.md §3 'Active backend instance'): username `mifos`, password `password`. In the API Explorer: click Authorize (top-right) → fineractBasicAuth tab → enter mifos / password → Authorize. Use tenant header `default` instead of `mifos-bank-2` when targeting the public sandbox server.
